name: basic
description: Two drafts revised over several messages, a message with two fences for one id, an ordinary code block inside a draft body, and a CRLF message. Expected versions follow AI section 13 (last-fence rule, numbering by appearance).

messages.text: Write a trip note and a packing list.

Here is the trip note.

```draft id="trip-note" rev="1" title="Trip note" lang="markdown"
# Trip note

We leave today.
The weather is fine.
See you there.
```

And the packing list.

```draft id="packing" rev="1" title="Packing"
## Day one
Bring water.
## Day two
Bring water.
Leave early.
```
Thanks. Make the weather line stronger.

First attempt:

```draft id="trip-note" rev="2"
# Trip note

We leave today.
The weather is great.
See you there.
```

Corrected attempt:

```draft id="trip-note" rev="2" title="Trip note"
# Trip note

We leave tomorrow.
The weather is perfect.
See you there.
Bring a hat.
```

```draft id="packing" rev="2"
## Day one
Bring water.
## Day two
Bring water and snacks.
Leave early.
```

Setup guide with a code block:

````draft id="setup-guide" title="Setup" lang="markdown"
Install the tool:

```sh
npm install example
```

Then restart.
````
